newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt wheat/barley, intvn barley/rye.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt wheat/barley, intvn barley/rye.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted the following rebates to export free-market grain to non-EU countries, grain traders said.
Member-country officials later confirmed the figures, adding the EU also granted licences to export 1,000 tonnes of free-market rye at a maximum rebate of 31.99 Ecus per tonne.
In the intervention tender, the EU sold 39,529 tonnes of Danish intervention barley at a minimum price of 97.22 Ecus per tonne for export to countries outside the EU, member country officials said.
It also sold 52,842 tonnes of German intervention rye at a minimum price of 96.04 Ecus per tonne. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
